ceu: ✦ The opposition between Venus and Uranus

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and your image. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between romance and friendships. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between family and your career. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between money and intimacy. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your image and relationships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and romance. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The opposition between Venus and Uranus creates some tension between your career and family. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.
